title: Classroom of the Elite
subtitle: Observation and emotional restraint
jpTitle: ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ
_guide_hero: Layout: Title (1-4 words), jpTitle (1-3 words), subtitle (3-6 words). Poster is right split image (2:3 portrait).

entry._guide: Layout: Centered giant text. Limit 15-40 words.
entry.breathQuote: I thought it was a show about high school drama. It turned out to be a masterclass in watching people reveal what they actually value.

reflection._guide: Layout: Right column split. Quote: 20-50 words. Tags: 2-4 items. Cards: 30-70 words.
reflection.quote: Ayanokoji introduced me to total emotional restraint. I started asking how much of my energy I waste reacting to things I should just be observing.
reflection.whatIKept: Leverage belongs to the person who needs the least validation.
reflection.definingScene: The season one ending monologue. The chilling realization that he views everyone as tools. It recontextualized every 'helpful' thing he had done.
reflection.whoItMadeMeThinkAbout: The parts of the corporate world where systems thinking replaces empathy.

thoughtCascade.thought: Wait — he engineered that entire outcome without taking credit.
He isn't helping them. He's arranging them.
He doesn't want to win. He wants to not be bothered.

_guide_thoughtCascade: Layout: Left-aligned timeline. Thought: 20-45 words. Micro: 2-5 words.

cinematicMoment._guide: Layout: Full width dark section. Body: 40-80 words. Image: 16:9 landscape.
cinematicMoment.title: The inner monologue.
cinematicMoment.body: After a whole season of seeming to learn the value of friendship, the voiceover reveals the truth: 'I've never once thought of you as an ally. All people are nothing but tools.' A terrifying display of absolute detachment.

memoryCards._guide: Layout: Hovering glass cards. Question: 5-12 words. Cards: text 30-50 words.
memoryCards.question: What stayed with me after the screen went dark?

cards.title: The Points
cards.text: A system that commodifies behavior. It made me look at how society tracks our worth.

cards.title: The Shadows
cards.text: Controlling the room without standing at the podium. The power of invisibility.

cards.title: The Monologue
cards.text: The voice inside that shows the gap between what people do and why they do it.

altMemories.question: What quietly changed?
altMemories.heading: I learned the value of silence.
altMemories.body: I used to speak up to prove I understood. This show taught me that giving away your perspective for free reduces your leverage. Sometimes the smartest move is to let people underestimate you.
altMemories.caption: Silence is data collection.

_guide_altMemories: Layout: Alternating split layout. Body: 50-100 words. Image: 1:1 or 4:5.

pullQuote._guide: Layout: Giant dramatic quote. Text: 10-30 words.
pullQuote.text: As long as I win in the end, that's all that matters.

timeline._guide: Layout: Center timeline nodes. Body: 30-60 words.

firstImpression.heading: A standard school hierarchy
firstImpression.body: I expected an underdog story — D-Class proves everyone wrong with the power of friendship.

whatShifted.heading: The hidden puppeteer
whatShifted.body: The protagonist wasn't learning to care. He was learning how the pieces moved on the board.

whatStayed.heading: Emotional detachment
whatStayed.body: The stark utility of separating emotions from objectives. A dangerous path, but highly effective.

items.line: to observe a room before deciding how to participate in it.
how often people give away their leverage just to feel heard.
the underlying systems that dictate why people act the way they do.

characters.name: Kiyotaka Ayanokoji
characters.mirror: He challenged my need for validation — the absolute extreme of systems thinking without empathy.

characters.name: Suzune Horikita
characters.mirror: She reflected the trap of believing intelligence alone is enough, without understanding social dynamics.

notes.text: People will tell you who they are if you're quiet enough to let them.

ideas.application: The person who knows the most while revealing the least controls the interaction.

continueJourney.because: Because I stopped performing my understanding and started keeping it.

recommendations.title: Code Geass
recommendations.reason: When strategy and manipulation are used to change the world.

recommendations.title: Death Note
recommendations.reason: The battle of intellects where visibility is fatal.
